claim: The Sahara walk in Lommel is an 11.70 km red-triangle-marked loop through dunes, lakes, heather and pine forest, starting at House of Nature (Speelpleinstraat 201, 3920 Lommel) and reaching the 30 m Reus van Bosland observation tower.
quote: The route spans 11.70 km through Bosland National Park. Parking is available at House of Nature (Speelpleinstraat 201, 3920 Lommel). The 'Reus van Bosland' stands 30 metres high, offering panoramic views up to 25 km on clear days. Follow red triangle markers throughout.

claim: The Sahara hiking area at Speelpleinstraat in 3920 Lommel is free to enter, has a dog off-leash area (hondenlosloopweide) and includes a children's play forest plus the Reus van Bosland watchtower.
quote: Speelpleinstraat z/n, 3920 Lommel ... Target price (adult) € 0,- ... Hondenlosloopweide ... Uitkijktoren - De Reus van Bosland ... Speelbos

claim: Nationaal Park Bosland groups distinct walking areas (Sahara, Pijnven, In den Brand, Kattenbos, Heuvelse Heide, Resterheide, Holven-'t Plat, Grote Hof-Hobos, Blauwe Kei-De Maat) and operates a wandelnetwerk where more than 70% of paths are quiet sand tracks.
quote: Pijnven ... 2,000 hectares of forest ... In den Brand ... rare sand dune system ... Kattenbos ... Leyssensmolen (grain mill from 1797) ... Resterheide ... buggy/wheelchair-accessible Lieveheersbeestjespad ... Bosland Wandelnetwerk ... 'meer dan 70%' on quiet sand paths.

claim: Heather around Lommel typically blooms mid-August to mid-September; prime spots are Heuvelse Heide (parking De Meerpaal, Boskantstraat 60), Kattenbos (2.2 km wheelchair-accessible Butterfly Walk), and Blekerheide reached by a steel pedestrian bridge over the Bocholt-Herentals canal (parking Lossingsweg).
quote: The heath usually blooms from mid-August to mid-September ... Heuvelse Heide ... Parking at De Meerpaal, Boskantstraat 60 ... Kattenbos ... 2.2-kilometer Butterfly Walk accommodates strollers and wheelchairs ... Blekerheide ... steel pedestrian bridge over the Bocholt-Herentals Canal. Parking at Lossingsweg z/n.

claim: Hageven-De Plateaux is a 600-ha cross-border reserve in Pelt (visitor centre De Wulp, Tussenstraat 10, Neerpelt) with eight walking routes from 1.38 km to 9.69 km; dogs allowed on-leash and the 1.38 km Hubert Lehaenpad is wheelchair/stroller accessible.
quote: Located in Limburg on the Belgian-Dutch border, this nature reserve spans 600 hectares ... Eight walking routes are available, ranging from 1.38 km to 9.69 km ... The 'Hubert Lehaenpad' is wheelchair and stroller-accessible at 1.38 km ... Dogs are welcome on-leash throughout the reserve.

claim: In den Brand near Hechtel-Eksel hosts the largest sandpit in Flanders with three marked loops of 2 km, 4.4 km and 5.5 km plus a 2-ha fenced off-leash dog park with separate zones for large and small dogs.
quote: The Nature Reserve In den Brand hosts the largest sandpit in Flanders. There are 3 walking routes mapped out from 2 to 5.5 km ... There is a 2-hectare dog park, fully fenced and located in a piece of woodland near the dunes of 'In den Brand'. There are separate zones for large and small dogs.

claim: Pijnven in Hechtel-Eksel is a 2,000+ ha pine and mixed forest area with play meadows, a treehouse and Butterfly Valley, traversed by routes including an easy 6.6 km orange loop.
quote: The Pijnven Orange Trail is an easy 6.6 km route offering scenic views within Pijnven Forest. The Pijnven is a forest of over 2000 hectares

claim: Kattenbos offers a 9.1 km loop through purple heathland and pine forest with chances to spot deer and badgers, best visited in August-September when the heather blooms; walks start at the Leyssensmolen car park.
quote: Kattenbos offers a 9.1 km hike through wide heathlands and quiet pine forests ... walk through purple heathlands and green pines, spot deer and badgers ... best time to visit is in August or September, when the heather bursts into bloom

claim: The Leyssensmolen, a wooden grain mill restored in 1988, sits at a popular walk start in Kattenbos and is open free to visitors on the 1st Sunday and 3rd Saturday of each month from 13:00–17:00.
quote: You can visit the mill for free every 1st Sunday and 3rd Saturday of the month between 1:00 PM and 5:00 PM ... In 1988 the mill was thoroughly restored and has been grinding grain again since then.

claim: Notable nearby outdoor attractions include the Lommelse Sahara suspension footbridge over the canal, the Fietsen door de Bomen 700 m elevated cycle path rising 10 m through the canopy in Hechtel-Eksel, and Klankenbos in Pelt with interactive sound-art sculptures.
quote: Fietsen door de Bomen ... a circular cycle path 700 metres long ... rising to a height of 10 metres ... Klankenbos ... interactive sound art sculptures created by European artists ... cross a suspension footbridge over the nearby canal

claim: Independent Komoot route data confirms multiple Sahara loops including a 12 km red, 5.9 km orange and 3.1 km blue children's trail, and longer 17.5–19.6 km Bosland border walks.
quote: A 12 km long red hiking trail, a 3.1 km blue children's trail, and a 5.9 km long orange trail ... A 19.6 kilometer walk that takes 5 hours ... A hiking route that is 17.5 kilometers long and takes approximately 4.5 hours

claim: Driving distance from Lommel to Maasmechelen (gateway to Mechelse Heide / Hoge Kempen National Park) is approximately 56–59 km, putting Mechelse Heide well outside the 30 km radius around Cuchara.
quote: The distance from Lommel to Maasmechelen is 35 miles by road (approximately 56 km). The road takes approximately 38 minutes. Alternatively, another source indicates the driving distance is 58.8 km
